The Impact You'll Make

Our IT Infrastructure Department at Danfoss is looking for an experienced colleague – Senior Professional, IT Client Engineer.

You will play a crucial part in ensuring the security, stability, and performance of our client/endpoint environment. This position, in alignment with the international team and service owners, involves managing our endpoint management systems, deploying software and security policies, resolving complex end-user technical issues, and optimizing the overall client architecture for performance and security. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in client engineering, excellent problem-solving skills, and a proven track record of managing complex end-user computing environments

This is your opportunity to join a dedicated team of professionals in a dynamic and innovative environment. At Danfoss, you will have the chance to make a real impact, work with leading-edge technology, and grow your career in a global company that is committed to sustainability and engineering a better future.

Your work location shall be either in **Sofia (Bulgaria) or Nordborg (Denmark). The job can be hybrid

What You’ll Be Doing

• Drive the performance, reliability, and scalability of our global Windows and macOS endpoint environment, ensuring employees have a secure and productive digital workplace.\

• Strengthen our security posture by implementing and optimizing endpoint security solutions, compliance standards, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) technologies.

• Act as a senior technical expert for complex endpoint and device-related challenges, identifying root causes and delivering long-term solutions that improve user experience.

• Shape and evolve our global client architecture through automation, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance and operational efficiency.

• Partner with colleagues across Security, Networking, Infrastructure, and Applications teams to deliver integrated solutions and maintain a high-quality end-user experience.

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years of experience in IT Client Engineering, Endpoint Management, or a similar role supporting large-scale enterprise environments.

• Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Manager (MEM), SCCM, co-management, and endpoint lifecycle management.

• Hands-on experience with Windows and macOS administration, endpoint security practices, and cloud identity solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).

• Solid scripting and automation skills, preferably using PowerShell, combined with a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

• Experience with ZTNA solutions such as Appgate is considered an advantage. Relevant Microsoft certifications are welcome but not required.

• Strong communication skills, the ability to collaborate effectively in a global team, and fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• Willingness and ability to travel internationally when needed.

What You'll Get From Us

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits on top of your salary. More information shall be provided during the recruitment process.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are passionate about endpoint management, client engineering, workplace technology, and cybersecurity, and you want to make a meaningful impact in a global organization, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today and help us build the future of the digital workplace at Danfoss!.

Our Commitment to Transparency

Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Internship Duration: 2 February 2027 to 25 June 2027

Do you want to work for an Architecture firm with sustainability at the heart of its strategy? Can you contribute with solutions from your academic studies? Are you currently studying to be an Architect? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

About us

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To use your academic knowledge of architectural fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you’ll have:

• Actively pursuing either a bachelor's or master's degree in Architectural Program or similar.

• Have good problem-solving skills

• Be a creative and technical thinker

• Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

• Sustainability, materials & reuse

• BIM, Revit, design & sketching

• Client consultancy & tendering

• Restoration & building preservation

• Competitions & visualizations

• Descriptions & quality assurance

• Urban Planning

These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

A place to work and so much more

At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape sustainable and customized solutions. By making use of our collective knowledge and curiosity, we create opportunities that contribute to good solutions for a future with ever-changing needs.

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

For us, it is important that the people we share everyday work with are allowed to be themselves, precisely because it is what brings out the best in you and those around us, both at work and at home.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role, please reach out to Susanne Bergholdt Damsted – subd@arkitema.com for Aarhus/Aalborg and Charlotte Lin Pedersen – capd@arkitema.com for Copenhagen.

Get to know us even better at our website, Arkitema where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at Arkitema.

Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key.

We focus on creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equal opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are considered valuable. We also take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes when we put together teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

NOTE

Kindly submit your CV, Cover Letter, and Portfolio. As only two attachment fields are available on the application page, please combine files where needed and upload them accordingly.

We only accept applications from active students who have not already completed an internship within their studies.

We are looking for a VP People & Culture to lead Boyum IT’s global People agenda and help ensure that our organization, leadership, culture and people practices continue to support our business ambitions and long-term growth.

About the role

This is a senior leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with close collaboration across the organization.

A central part of the role is being a visible ambassador for our culture and values. Our Energy for LIFE culture — Family, Social, Fit and Excellence — is an important part of who we are, and you will play a key role in protecting what works, strengthening what matters and helping the culture evolve as the business develops.

The role combines strategic People leadership with a pragmatic and hands-on approach. You will advise the CEO and senior leadership on organizational, leadership and People matters while making sure our People practices, leadership capabilities and employee experience work effectively in everyday life.

Key responsibilities

People Strategy, Organization & Leadership

• Lead the global People strategy aligned with Boyum IT’s business priorities.

• Advise the CEO and senior leadership on people, organization, leadership and culture.

• Lead organizational design, workforce planning, succession and leadership development.

• Use workforce data and insights to support business and organizational decisions.

Culture & Employee Experience

• Act as a visible culture ambassador and role model for Boyum IT and Energy for LIFE.

• Protect and strengthen the culture as the organization develops and changes.

• Ensure culture is reflected in leadership behaviour, collaboration, decision-making and People practices.

• Oversee engagement, well-being, retention and employee experience.

• Translate employee feedback into meaningful improvements.

Talent, Performance & Reward

• Oversee attraction, development and retention of talent.

• Ensure meaningful leadership and specialist career paths.

• Lead the approach to performance, development, compensation and benefits in collaboration with leaders and Finance.

Change, Governance & Risk

• Lead the people and culture aspects of transformation, restructuring and M&A integration.

• Ensure scalable global People policies, governance and employment compliance.

• Oversee employee relations, employment risk and relevant external stakeholder relationships.

People Operations, Data & ESG

• Lead and develop the People team.

• Ensure efficient and scalable People operations and continue developing HiBob as our central HR platform.

• Use People data and analytics to support decisions.

• Own the people-related ESG and social sustainability agenda in partnership with Finance.

Leadership expectations

As VP People & Culture, you are expected to lead beyond the People function. You put Boyum IT’s overall interests ahead of functional interests, act as a trusted and constructive advisor to the CEO and leadership team and combine strategic thinking with pragmatic execution. You build trust across countries and functions, create clarity and accountability, and consistently role-model our Energy for LIFE culture.

What we expect you to bring

• 10+ years of progressive People/HR experience, including senior HR leadership responsibility.

• Strong business understanding and the ability to translate business priorities into organizational, leadership and people priorities.

• Experience with organizational development, leadership advisory, workforce planning, talent, succession and change.

• International experience from a multi-country organization.

• Experience leading and developing a People/HR team.

• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to advise and challenge senior leaders constructively.

• A pragmatic and hands-on approach, with the ability to move between strategic topics and day-to-day realities.

• High integrity, sound judgment and discretion.

• Full professional proficiency in English; German is a strong advantage.

• Experience from a private equity-backed environment and/or M&A or integration work is a strong advantage.

You are a visible and credible culture ambassador who builds trust across the organization, leads by example and helps ensure that our Energy for LIFE culture is reflected in how we lead, collaborate and make decisions.

Success in the role

Success in this role means that Boyum IT has the right organizational structure, leadership capability and people practices to support the business; that leaders are equipped to lead effectively; and that our Energy for LIFE culture remains strong, visible and recognizable as we grow and change.

About Boyum IT

Boyum IT is an international software company with colleagues across multiple countries and more than 50 nationalities.Our culture is built around Energy for LIFE — Family, Social, Fit and Excellence — reflecting our ambition to create an environment where people can perform, develop and thrive while contributing to the success of the company. We believe strong business performance and a healthy workplace should reinforce each other.

Work conditions

• Full-time position

• Based in Aarhus

• Office-based or hybrid work environment

• International collaboration across countries, functions and time zones may be required

Interested?

If this sounds like the right next step for you, we’d be happy to hear from you. Please apply using the form below, or submit your application here.We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Do you want to be at the forefront of managing initiatives that enable next-generation Laser Systems for quantum computers, sensors, and communication systems? Do you thrive on turning complex challenges into structured plans and delivering results that push the boundaries of innovation?

**Then this job as Technical Project Manager for Quantum Systems at Hamamatsu Photonics may be the right job for you!

Being in the middle of the second quantum revolution, this is a great time to join us. Our continued success has set us on an exciting growth path—not just in Denmark, but across our global organization. Hamamatsu Photonics, is an inspiring place to work, where we encourage both personal and career development.

You will join a highly skilled and dedicated team of engineers and scientists and play a key role in ensuring successful delivery of projects that develop advanced laser systems and accessories for top-tier quantum technology customers.

**The Role:

**As a member of our Quantum Systems engineering team, you will lead the development, assembly, and testing of custom laser system products and prototypes based on ultra-stable fiber lasers. You interface with sales and support teams to provide updates on product developments and technical advice on customer enquiries as well as assisting with after sales support and repairs/upgrades.

**We are passionate about Quantum Technology! If you are enthusiastic about quantum technologies and computing too, in this position you will:

**

• Lead and manage technical projects from concept to delivery, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met following Hamamatsu Photonics Product and Prototype development processes

• Coordinate cross-functional teams of optical, mechanical and electronics engineers, commercial stake holders, and production specialists to achieve project goals

• Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external customers, providing clear communication and progress updates.

• Develop project plans, risk assessments, and resource allocations to ensure smooth execution.

• Support strategic decision-making by providing insights on project feasibility, technical challenges, and customer requirements.

**More about you:

**As a strong candidate for this position, we hope that you can tick all or most of the following boxes:

• A relevant educational qualification (Master level) is required, preferably gained within a photonics research environment

• Strong background in project management within high-tech or engineering environments (ideally in an industrial context)

• Experience with complex, multi-disciplinary projects, ideally in photonics, optics, or quantum technologies.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders at all levels.

• Familiarity with project management tools and methodologies (e.g. PRINCE or similar).

• A proactive mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)

• Willingness to travel up to 10% annually, potentially globally

We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

• A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

• An annual bonus program.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months.

• Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning.

• Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination.

• Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen.

• Free parking at our Birkerød site.

• Social activities through our Employee Association.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Passionate about your field of interest? Are you interested in a collaboration with Inwatec and learn from our team of dedicated and playful "Laundrynerds"? Then we might have something in store for you.

At Inwatec, we are in a constant hurry to bring our smart and innovative ideas to life. Therefore, we are always interested to hear from talented people, if they want to try out their talent in our successful company. We constantly look out for skilled and innovative people who are enthusiastic about witnessing smart inventions to be implemented in the real world.

We are looking for:

• Students wanting to get involved in our company during their studies

• Collaboration with Semester Projects, Bachelor Theses, and Master Theses

• Internships

• You are flexible and have a good sense of humour

• You are curious when it comes to learning about new innovations

• You might be interested in turning your project into a student job

We offer you:

• An exciting and challenging place with great and dedicated colleagues in a fast-growing company

• International environment

• Large degree of freedom and an opportunity to make your influence count

• Informal and flexible working environment

• New and inspiring office facilities

INWATEC - THE LAUNDRYNERDS

Inwatec ApS develops and produces machines for industrial laundries worldwide. Our niche is to implement automation projects that can make a difference for businesses. We are a fast-moving company in rapid development with a dynamic, as well as a very dedicated team. We love our informal work environment, where every idea is taken seriously and everybody is treated equally. On Fridays, we meet at our bar for an after-work beer, a barbecue, or some ping-pong. We also love training our counter-strike skills together for our successful FirmaCS teams after work.

Sounds good? What are you waiting for? Apply now at www.inwatec.dk/job

The Role

Our purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you'll make an impact

The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

What you'll do

• 
Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.

• 
Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.

• 
Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.

• 
Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.

• 
Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.

• 
Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.

• 
Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.

• 
Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

Success looks like

• 
First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• 
First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.

• 
Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.

• 
Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.

• 
Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.

• 
Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

What you'll bring with you

Critical competencies

• 
Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• 
Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.

• 
Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.

• 
Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

• 
Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.

• 
Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

Experience we would like to see

We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

• 
Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET

• 
Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React

• 
Comfortable with SQL and relational data

• 
Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review

• 
Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs

• 
Some exposure to automated testing

• 
Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not

• 
Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

How we use AI in this hiring process

We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

• 
The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.

• 
What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

At Planday, we offer you

• 
Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• 
On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• 
Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• 
Flexible remote work

• 
Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• 
Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• 
Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.occupation: Chauffør til fælgværksted i Søborg – Hjulfix / Driver for rim workshop in Søborg – Hjulfix
jobs.description:
Vil du have et job, hvor du er på farten hver dag og møder kunderne ansigt til ansigt? Hos Hjulfix i Søborg søger vi en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der står for afhentning og levering af hjul og fælge hos vores kunder. Det er primært værksteder, bilforhandlere og skadecentre i Storkøbenhavn og på Sjælland.

Hos Hjulfix kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores værksted for reparation af fælge i Søborg, hvor vi renoverer, retter og lakerer omkring 10.000 fælge om året. Du bliver bindeleddet mellem kunderne og værkstedet, så din indsats har stor betydning for, at fælgene kommer sikkert frem og tilbage til tiden.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

• 
PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

• 
Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

• 
Expertise in visual attention and perception

• 
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

• 
Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

• 
Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

• 
Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

• 
Good command of statistics

• 
Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

• 
Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

• 
Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be in English and submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". 

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

• 
A letter of motivation (max. 1 page)

• 
A detailed CV

• 
Master and PhD degree certificates, if available

• 
A complete and numbered list of publications 

• 
Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

• 
Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

****AAK Location

**This role will be based at our site in Aarhus.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Global Application Excellence Manager to join AAK’s Applied Innovation organisation and serve as one of our global technical authorities within Chocolate & Confectionery Fats (CCF). Combining deep expertise in confectionery formulation, fat functionality and processing with innovation and industry knowledge, you will help strengthen AAK’s position as The Co-Development Company.

In this role, you will expand and strengthen AAK’s application knowledge by developing and validating customer-relevant proof points, leading lower-complexity product development projects and supporting Scientists on medium- and long-term innovation programmes. You will translate technical expertise into practical customer solutions that demonstrate the value of AAK’s portfolio.

Working alongside our other Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery, you will connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams, global functions and external industry stakeholders. You will help ensure knowledge and expertise are shared across regions, while identifying customer needs and market opportunities that can be translated into differentiated solutions and future innovation.

As a global technical reference point, you will support regional teams through technical guidance, training, customer projects and troubleshooting. You will also contribute to the development of AAK’s Confectionery Centre of Excellence and Customer Innovation Network, helping build capabilities and consistent application expertise across the organisation.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as a global subject matter expert in Chocolate & Confectionery applications, with deep knowledge of CCF formulation, fat functionality, processing technologies and ingredient interactions.

• Connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams and global technical functions to strengthen knowledge sharing and ensure expertise is effectively leveraged across AAK.

• Design, develop and validate compelling application proof points that demonstrate customer value and differentiate AAK’s solutions.

• Lead lower-complexity product development projects while supporting Scientists on more complex, medium- and long-term innovation programmes.

• Translate new products and technologies into customer demonstrations, application evidence, technical documentation and materials that support successful commercialisation.

• Support regional teams with complex application and processing challenges through troubleshooting, technical guidance, customer workshops, factory trials and evaluations.

• Strengthen the Confectionery Centre of Excellence by developing application methods, evaluation protocols, best practices, technical tools and knowledge resources.

• Deliver AAK Academy training and technical learning programmes while supporting the development of the CCF Customer Innovation Network and wider technical capabilities.

• Analyse customer innovation projects and market developments to identify recurring needs, application gaps, future proof points and opportunities for new product development.

• Represent AAK within the wider confectionery ecosystem through relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers and industry experts, while supporting technology scouting and competitive benchmarking.

• Contribute to intellectual property activities, including technical evidence, application validation and competitive differentiation where relevant.

**About You

**

• MSc or PhD in Food Science, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8–10+ years of relevant industry experience within chocolate, confectionery, specialty fats or related food applications.

• Recognised expertise in Chocolate & Confectionery Fats, including formulation, fat functionality, ingredient interactions and processing technologies across applications such as chocolate, compounds, fillings, spreads and caramel.

• Proven experience in application development, product development, scale-up, customer trials and commercialisation.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market trends and technical knowledge into differentiated application solutions and compelling customer value.

• Experience working across global, cross-functional organisations, connecting technical experts and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong troubleshooting, process optimisation and communication skills, with a passion for knowledge sharing, capability building and mentoring.

• Experience with innovation processes, technology scouting, competitive benchmarking or intellectual property activities is an advantage; fluent in English and willing to travel internationally.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

**For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

• Cognitive Neuroscience (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

• Methods 4: Bayesian Computational Modeling (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

• Social and Cultural Dynamics (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

MA in Linguistics:

• Computational Linguistics (2 hours/week, 12 weeks)

Programming skills necessary - see course description.

BA in Linguistics:

• Studiume Generale (2 hours/week, 13 weeks) (please notice; course in Danish)

Qualifications

Applicants should have:

• A solid background in the relevant academic areas for the position, including good grades for the course they are applying for, and other related courses.

• Good communication skills, including the ability to work well with course coordinators, the ability to communicate well with students, and the ability to facilitate discussion and collaboration between students.

• The ability to help course coordinators in preparing class activities, and to interpret and implement class plans in a clear and organized way.

• Is enrolled as a student at Aarhus University when teaching.

We recommend that you participate in a basic pedagogical course for student instructors, lasting approx. 12 hours. Participation in the course as an instructor is paid once during your study period.

Terms of employment

In most courses, instructors will be required to teach a total of 26 hours. For each hour taught, instructors will receive 1.5 hours paid preparation time, for a total of 65 paid hours. If the instructor has to teach the same content to two different classes, the preparation time for class two will only be 0.75 hours paid preparation time, for a total of 55,25 paid hours.

The hourly rate of pay is DKK 291,80, including holiday pay.

Application process

When applying, please attach your application letter, CV, and grade transcripts.

You are more than welcome to apply for more than one course, please write your prioritized order for the courses. Each course requires a separate application. You will need to write them in the same document or attach it as extra attachments in the application system.

Each application should include a letter stating:

• Which course you are applying to serve as instructor for.

• A short motivation for your application for that course.

• A short description of relevant knowledge and skills for the role of instructor, specific to the course you are applying for.

Application letters for each course should be no longer than a single A4 page.

The deadline is 9 November, and we hope to get back to you before Christmas.

If you have any questions, please contact Head of Department, Joshua Charles Skewes at afdelingsleder.lics@cc.au.dk.

About Arts

The Faculty of Arts is one of Northern Europe’s most significant faculties for research and higher education in the humanities, theology and education. Within this broad academic scope, the faculty comprises approximately 700 researchers, 200 PhD students, 9,000 Bachelor’s and Master’s degree students, and 1,500 further and continuing education students. We believe that the best ideas arise when different perspectives meet – and that research, teaching and innovation are best developed in dialogue with the surrounding society.

You can find more information here: Faculty of Arts | Aarhus University

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you have a keen interest in financial markets and sustainability? Do you enjoy developing high‑quality financial analysis with strategic impact? And are you ready to take a key role in advising some of the largest and most complex corporates in Denmark on capital structure, funding strategy and sustainability? This entry-level role offers rapid learning and broad exposure to complex advisory work.

What You Will Be Doing

As an Analyst in our Corporate & Sustainability Advisory team, you will work alongside senior colleagues to deliver strategic financial advice to large corporate clients. You will be part of our newly integrated Denmark and Norway team, collaborating across markets to provide tailor-made solutions on capital structure, funding strategy, and sustainability initiatives.

• Conduct high-quality financial statement analysis with strategic importance for clients

• Develop expertise in capital structure, credit ratings, acquisition capacity, and funding strategy while integrating sustainability initiatives to enhance financial outcomes and value creation

• Prepare clear and engaging client presentations and management materials

• Support client engagements, pitches, and analytical projects across markets

• Contribute to improving analytical models and client materials

About You

To succeed in this role, you should have:

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related field with strong academic record

• Strong analytical capabilities and commercial mindset

• Genuine interest in sustainability and financial markets

• Structured working approach with clear communication skills

• Fluency in Danish and English for cross-country collaboration

• Ability to deliver high-quality results in collaborative environments

Experience from banking, consulting, treasury, or client-facing roles would be beneficial for your success in this position.

What We Offer You

You will join a highly skilled advisory team within a leading Nordic financial institution. We provide exposure to complex projects and collaboration across diverse teams. Our supportive learning environment focuses on continuous feedback, and you will be part of a pan-Nordic network of professionals with strong opportunities for development within strategic corporate advisory and sustainable finance.

Are you ready for the next step?

We believe diverse backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our team, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

For more information, please contact Head of Corporate & Sustainability Advisory DK/NO Anders Johannessen at ajohan@danskebank.dk or Chief Analyst Hanne Brendstrup at habre@danskebank.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Job Description

Do you have solid experience leading large-scale IT projects? Are you motivated by delivering innovative IT solutions to complex, society-critical challenges? If so, you may be our next colleague in the role of IT Manager at Netcompany. As a Manager, you will be challenged in a position that requires strong leadership capabilities as well as technical expertise.

Responsibilities and technologies

As an IT Manager, you will be responsible for leading large-scale IT projects from initiation through successful delivery. You will manage project teams, oversee project risks, and ensure high standards of quality, delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction. In addition, you will play a key role in client advisory services, business development activities, and proposal management.

Beyond your leadership responsibilities, you will be expected to contribute with strong technical expertise. You will act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on technical solution design and implementation, helping project teams and clients solve complex challenges.

Alongside your project management responsibilities, you will serve as a mentor to consultants and senior consultants. This long-term mentoring relationship will give you the opportunity to support, guide, and contribute to the professional development of your mentees throughout their careers at Netcompany.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Leading projects and ensuring successful delivery and progress, typically based on agile development methodologies.

• Participating in steering committee meetings with senior representatives from both Netcompany and the client organization.

• Advising the client on project deliverables.

• Coordinating activities across multiple project workstreams, including testing, organizational implementation, and software development.

• Leading proposal teams and conducting development and performance discussions with your mentees.

About you

We expect you to hold a masters's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you have:

• 
Strong technical expertise and relevant experience within the IT industry.

• 
Proven experience leading large and complex IT delivery projects, including projects utilizing agile development methodologies.

• 
Strong commercial awareness combined with the ability to build trust and lead high-performing teams.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, partnerships, and commercial growth? Are you motivated by working across countries, vendors, and cultures to create business impact?

At NTI Group, a leading Autodesk partner operating across 15 markets in EMEA and Brazil, we are looking for a commercially driven Global Software Partnerships Manager to take ownership of our portfolio of Global Software Partnerships solutions and accelerate growth across the Group.

Your mission

As Global Software Partnerships Manager, you will be responsible for driving the success of NTI Group's Global software Partnerships business across all markets.

You will act as the key link between software vendors, distributors, local teams, and Group leadership, ensuring strong partnerships, successful go-to-market initiatives, and sustainable business growth.

What you'll do

• Own and develop NTI Group's Global Software Partnerships software portfolio

• Build and strengthen strategic relationships with software vendors and distributors

• Drive global go-to-market activities and commercial growth initiatives

• Support local sales organizations with pipeline development and sales enablement

• Lead vendor reviews, partnership activities, and follow-up actions

• Monitor business performance, KPIs, and growth opportunities across markets

• Facilitate knowledge sharing and build a strong international product community

What we're looking for

You bring solid commercial experience from software, partner, product, channel, or vendor management and have a proven track record of driving growth through partnerships and go-to-market initiatives.

We imagine that you:

• Have 5+ years of relevant experience

• Are experienced in working with software vendors and partner programs

• Understand pipeline management, forecasting, and business performance metrics

• Thrive in an international environment with many stakeholders

• Combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach

• Communicate fluently in English

Experience from software, AEC, manufacturing, or design technology industries is an advantage.

Why join NTI Group?

This is a unique opportunity to influence NTI Group's global software portfolio and play a key role in shaping strategic vendor partnerships across 15 countries.

We offer:

• Competitive salary, pension scheme, and private health insurance

• Excellent lunch arrangement with in-house chefs

• A high degree of freedom, flexibility, and trust

• A collaborative and supportive international environment

• An inclusive culture where diversity is a strength

Travel

The role includes international travel for vendor meetings, business reviews, and collaboration with country organizations.

We hire when we find the right candidate, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Contact person:

Lars Kanneworff, Sales Director, +4544350737, LK@nti-group.com. Please note we do not receive applications and resumes by mail.

Learn more about us at www.nti-group.com
